rationale: EASA NPA 2025-07(B) (Proposed DS.AI) directly sets out proposed specifications and AMC/GM covering operational domain/ODD definition (GM1 AI.150), risk assessment and continuous risk assessment (DS.AI.160), system development assurance (AMC1 AI.150), supervised-ML learning assurance via recognition of ED-324/ARP6983 (AMC2 AI.150), configuration and life-cycle data (AMC1/AMC2 AI.150), and in-service monitoring capabilities (DS.AI.160, AMC1 AI.160(a)). Across all artifact uses, the document is strictly characterized as proposed civil guidance rather than final AMC/GM or an approved application.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-002-R2 (NPA 2025-07 (B), PDF pp. 24–26, DS.AI.150, AMC1 AI.150, AMC2 AI.150)
limitations: NPA 2025-07(B) is a Notice of Proposed Amendment, not a final adopted EASA Decision.

The proposed DS.AI framework contains scope boundaries (e.g., Level 1/2 systems, excluding direct catastrophic contributions) that require failure-condition allocation when evaluating specific applications.
